_comment: Editorial content for PIAHCLA, the 'A' class share line of PIA Holding Company Limited. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: all three image fields are null. This is a holding company, not an operating business, so it sells no products and the products list is empty.
description: PIA Holding Company Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 21 March 2024 under a Scheme of Arrangement sanctioned by the SECP, and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange on 27 May 2024. Its principal activity is to act as the holding company of its subsidiaries and associates — PIA Investments Limited, Skyrooms (Private) Limited and Sabre Travel Network Pakistan (Private) Limited — and, after the first completion of the privatisation of Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Limited, it holds a 33.33% shareholding in PIACL. Its capital is divided into 'A' class shares of Rs 10 each, listed as PIAHCLA, and 'B' class shares of Rs 5 each, listed as PIAHCLB, each class a separate listed security that the exchange records as 'Ordinary' shares of its class.
headOffice: 4th Floor, PIA Building, 49-AKM Fazal-e-Haq Road, Blue Area, Islamabad, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: https://piahcl.com.pk (company profile, Scheme of Arrangement, subsidiaries, 33.33% PIACL shareholding, share capital and registered office), https://piahcl.com.pk/management (CEO) and https://piahcl.com.pk/investor-information (the exchange symbols for the 'A' and 'B' class lines), with the PSX company profile for PIAHCLA at https://dps.psx.com.pk/company/PIAHCLA (incorporation and listing dates, business description, address) (accessed 2026-10-17).
